disclaimer: These readings are impersonal summaries of official US government statistics. They are not financial or investment advice and are not a recommendation to buy or sell any security or to take any particular action.

treasury_yield_curve.label: Treasury yield curve spreads
treasury_yield_curve.source: U.S. Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
treasury_yield_curve.note: Spreads are calculated from official Treasury par yields. A negative spread means that maturity pair is inverted. This is a description of official yields, not a trade signal.

jobless_claims.label: Weekly initial unemployment insurance claims
jobless_claims.source: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, national weekly claims file
jobless_claims.note: Seasonally adjusted initial claims (column c5) and the official four-week average (column c8) from the ETA national weekly file, converted from thousands. A week-over-week change is our difference between two official weekly readings. Incomplete later weeks are omitted.

broad_dollar.label: Nominal broad U.S. dollar index
broad_dollar.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates, series JRXWTFB_N.B
broad_dollar.note: Official index level as published. Days marked ND in the Board's file are left as gaps and are not filled.
